description: Set a sequence's in and out points, zero point (start time), work area (Premiere Pro 26.5 or later) and playhead position. Times are seconds. In, out and zero point are one undo step; the playhead and work area are not undoable

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

workAreaIn.description: Work area in, seconds (26.5 or later)

workAreaOut.description: Work area out, seconds (26.5 or later)

zeroPoint.description: Start time of the timecode, seconds

name: set_sequence_times
title: Set Sequence Times
